schema_note: Matches the field structure of the current IAU MDC streamfulldata.json. The MDC assigns LP, IAUNo, Code, and provisional designation.

solution.Remarks: Blind GMN identification; significant annually in 2022-2026; supported by legacy CAMS and SonotaCo meteors; no parent body claimed.
References: Li, B. et al., manuscript in preparation

calculation.membership: 95 deduplicated GMN members in the five independently significant years 2022-2026
calculation.mean_type: unweighted arithmetic mean; angular variables do not cross 0/360 in this sample
calculation.semimajor_axis: derived from mean q/(1-mean e) for internal consistency
calculation.radiant_daily_motion: ordinary least-squares slope versus solar longitude
calculation.selection_warning: LoSb and LoSe are the observed bounds of the frozen selection window, not an exposure-corrected activity duration.
